changelog: Four things found by using the previous build. A task that has not finished is no longer drawn as a failure: opening a run while it was still going showed every subtitle that had not started yet as "Failed" in red, so a run that was working looked broken start to finish - unfinished tasks now say Queued or Running, and a status the page does not recognise is neutral rather than an accusation. A plain click in the library selects and views a row, and no longer adds it to the selection: browsing accumulated a batch nobody asked for, so right-click is again the only way to pick a row (shift-click and shift+right-click still work as before), and the selection still survives a search. One picked row no longer jumps to the top of the list - picked rows sort to the top only once there are two, which is when there is a group worth keeping together. The run's counts line names its failures and its no-ops again: "61/459 done (13%) - 3 failed - 5 already in sync", where the last figure is a subtitle that was already aligned and so wrote nothing, previously indistinguishable from one that had been written. The overall progress bar is a visible indicator rather than a 3px hairline.
